unresolved.note: Diktum KEDUA of the 2027 SKB leaves the final dates of 1 Ramadan, Idul Fitri and Idul Adha 1448 H to a Keputusan Menteri Agama (sidang isbat). The dates follow the SKB and stay non-provisional; re-check after the isbat and amend the related joint leave days if the SKB is changed.

Under Diktum KELIMA, joint leave for ASN follows separate rules (a Keputusan Presiden); joint leave for private institutions is set by each institution (Diktum KEENAM). Whether schools close on joint leave days is a school-calendar setting, not part of this dataset.
Days from January to June 2028 are not covered: the 2028 SKB is normally set around September 2027. Add them when it is published.
